data.title: Turkey blocks at least 12 Grok posts on national security grounds - Stockholm Center for Freedom
data.description: Turkish courts have blocked access to at least 12 X posts by artificial intelligence chatbot Grok since February 2025 on national security and public order grounds, according to an analysis by the Expression Interrupted press freedom monitoring platform. The blocked posts concerned allegations involving government officials, politicians and public institutions, including claims of favoritism in […]
